text:
tariq: Quick follow-up on compacting token events — propose a two-path ingest: cheap compact envelopes for most traffic + async expansion for audits. Thoughts?

mona: Sounds promising. Compact envelope = {fp, tenant, token_delta, ts, src_seq, hint}. No payloads. Need collision detection and a canonicalizer.

diego: For dedupe include src_seq & connection_id. Shard by tenant_id to keep locality. Expander runs co-located.

zoe: Sampling plan: 1% global always-expanded, tenant opt-in for full. Also a 0.1% shadow stream for drift detection.

billing-bot: rough cost delta: full path ~ $0.0025/1k, compact ~40% cheaper (estimate).

tariq: Operational: keep expanded rows 90d, then rollup/archival. Add alert if compact vs full delta > 0.5% for 1h.

mona: On-demand expansion API: POST /admin/expand?tenant=.. returns job id; charge tenant for work. Dry-run to estimate size.

diego: Late arrivals handled via provisional windows + finalizer with CAS to ledger.

zoe: Action items: prototype generator (diego), A/B 1% for 2w (mona), retention/cost model (tariq). If no objections I'll file RFC update. :thumbsup:
